fact: The Mauritania synthesis presented at the Countdown to 2030 annual meeting of 16-20 June 2025 reviews health-facility data in DHIS2 for 2019-2024 and states that report completeness is low against target, particularly at district level, that hospital and private-facility data are missing, and that only the hospitals of Hodh Gharbi and Guidimagha have data available and integrated in the database; it recommends strengthening the integration of hospital data and a review of SNIS completeness, notably for 2024.
title: Rapport d'analyse : Analyse des indicateurs de santé reproductive, maternelle, néonatale, infantile et adolescente pour 2019-2024 : Document de synthèse — Mauritanie
publisher: Countdown to 2030 / Ministère de la Santé (Mauritanie)
